mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the finished kaleidoscope was most worthwhile: the few loose shapes became a shifting crowd of colours.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taping the mirrors was straightforward and less interesting than seeing what they did.

surprise.text: I liked learning that leaving space in the colour drum lets the pieces slide and change the pattern.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each followed a concrete construction goal.

continue.text: I would continue: the final pattern and the explanation of repeated reflections made me curious about what the next construction might do.
